uri.title: Connection URI
uri.description: redis:// or rediss:// for direct Redis; grpc:// or grpc+tls:// for Flight SQL. URL-encode credentials. Use URI read_timeout to bound Redis reads.

connection_type.description: Flight SQL requires a separately operated compatible SQL gateway.

schemas.description: Exact database schema names to discover. Use an empty string for a gateway without schemas. Only tables and views exposed through ADBC metadata are read.

catalog.description: Optional exact catalog name; required when stream names would otherwise be ambiguous across catalogs.

batch_size.description: Redis Arrow batch row limit. Gateway batch sizes are controlled by its server.

database_options.description: Additional trusted ADBC driver database options. URI, driver and transaction settings cannot be overridden.
